title: Add 'md auto-save' command
description: Pre-commit hook (sibling to auto-delete) that stages the tasks file so it rides along in every commit. Extract a shared hookBlock helper from auto_delete.go, add auto_save.go, wire into main.go, add e2e coverage. Marker-based enablement, no git config. No default-branch guard, no backup/restore (never modifies content).
